description: This file manages proxy bypass logic for Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) localhost connections, including determining if a URL is a loopback address, checking proxy environment variables, and temporarily modifying NO_PROXY environment settings for loopback URLs.

classes.name: NoProxyLeaseManager
classes.description: Manages temporary modifications to NO_PROXY environment variables for loopback CDP URLs, including lease acquisition and release logic.

methods.name: getDirectAgentForCdp
methods.description: Returns a non-proxy HTTP or HTTPS agent for loopback URLs, or undefined otherwise.

methods.name: hasProxyEnv
methods.description: Checks if any proxy-related environment variables are set.

methods.name: withNoProxyForLocalhost
methods.description: Executes a function with NO_PROXY environment variables set to include localhost addresses.

methods.name: withNoProxyForCdpUrl
methods.description: Temporarily modifies NO_PROXY environment variables for a specific CDP URL during the execution of a function.
